name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri Volkov's journey into motorsport began not in the grandstands, but in the workshops of his father's engineering firm. He honed his technical skills working on high-performance engines. He transitioned to racing after completing his engineering degree, initially as a performance engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous approach and data-driven decision-making. Before joining Garage 59, Dimitri oversaw a successful GT program at SMP Racing, where his leadership led to several championship wins.

Dimitri is known for his pragmatic and methodical approach to team management. He prioritizes data analysis and strategic planning, always seeking incremental improvements. He values a calm and focused environment, favoring logic over emotion when making critical decisions. He expects the same dedication to the details from his team. 

What sets Dimitri apart is his ability to blend technical expertise with managerial acumen. He is not afraid to get his hands dirty, often seen poring over telemetry data or offering solutions to complex mechanical issues. Dimitri's deep understanding of both the technical and human aspects of motorsport makes him a formidable team principal, driven by a desire to maximize every opportunity for success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side
physical.description: Dimitri is a lean man with a serious demeanor, often seen sporting a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace, with all tools and equipment in their designated places.
Prefers to communicate through written reports and data visualizations rather than lengthy verbal discussions.
